From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onyx Systems onboarding: COI uploads, PO routing & vendor forms

Hi Daniel / Onyx team,

Welcome — excited to get Onyx set up in our procurement system. To keep things moving, please see the initial onboarding checklist below and return the requested documents so we can issue a PO and start the first invoice run.

Required items (priority order):
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached: redwood_vendor_form_v1.pdf)
- W-9 (PDF)
- Certificate(s) of Insurance:
  - Commercial General Liability (CGL): minimum $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
  - Professional Liability / Errors & Omissions (E&O): minimum $1,000,000
  - Cyber Liability: minimum $2,000,000 (or proof of cyber insurance application + ETA)
  - COIs should name "Redwood Inference, Inc." as Additional Insured and include Waiver of Subrogation where available
- Bank details / remit-to info for AP (or confirm we should route payment via 3rd-party service)

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (process + timelines) and the vendor form above. Our standard PO terms are net30 (USD) unless otherwise negotiated. Please indicate the billing contact and preferred invoice delivery (email to ap@redwood.co or upload to our Box link).

If you can upload documents to the Box folder (link below) that’s ideal; alternatively reply with attachments. Let us know if you need Redwood's exact Additional Insured wording — I can paste it for your broker.

Target timeline: COI + W9 within 48–72 hours would be great. If Cyber cannot be provided immediately, please share an ETA and any supporting evidence.

Box upload: https://redwood.box.com/s/onyx-onboarding-uploads
Procurement ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-8231

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_vendor_form_v1.pdf, vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf

Quick notes:

- About Additional Insured: our broker asks for the exact language you require. Please paste the wording and we’ll request it from the carrier.
- We can upload everything to the Box link you provided; happy to send to ap@redwood.co if you prefer direct email for invoices.

Will follow up with the cyber COI and a signed vendor form early next week.

Best,
Daniel Rivera

Thanks Daniel — that helps. Please ask the broker to include the following Additional Insured language exactly as shown when they reissue the COI: 

"Redwood Inference, Inc., its subsidiaries and affiliates, and their respective officers, directors, employees and agents are named as Additional Insured on a primary and non-contributory basis, and a Waiver of Subrogation is provided in favor of Redwood Inference, Inc."

For PO routing and remittance: please route invoices to ap@redwood.co. Our AP contact is Marcus Lin (cc’d). Marcus, can you confirm the remit address and PO reference we should provide Onyx?

If you prefer, sign the vendor form and upload to Box (DocuSign is also fine). Once we receive COIs + W-9 + signed vendor form, we’ll issue a PO (usually within 1 business day).

Thanks,
Irene
